items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: In the bus, on the train, bands that could afford to ride trains, like Raglin Ellington, -- Junior Ragman, he played with Ellington.

ctx.x: Barney Begard. You know what happened? Stan, sit down a minute, boy, this is funny. Old Junior would go by, and he was a natural kleptomaniac, and stealing booze from everybody. Well, he found a bottle behind the seat or beside the seat. He would grab it and take him a good swig.

And so Barney Begard one time tricked him, and he peed in the bottle. And Old Junior, thinking it was booze, it was all the same color, man, he upped that bottle and swallowed that stuff. And so Barney says, now, I hope you know what you just did. Boy, those guys used to do a lot of things. (Unintelligible) told me about that.
